method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Moderna pins hopes on ‘game-changer’ for cancer vaccines
Equities.summary: Technology behind blockbuster Covid jabs is yielding promising results in oncology treatment
Equities.reason: Major biotech breakthrough that is provoking a sector-wide re-rate and lifting risk appetite for growth/innovative equities — a clear market leadership signal for biotech within broader equities.

Equities.title: Cancer vaccine from Moderna, Merck shows promise in late-stage trial; both stocks soar
Equities.summary: The combination regimen significantly extended the time patients lived without their melanoma returning, compared with Keytruda alone.
Equities.reason: Confirms clinical data driving strong share gains for major pharma/biotech names; positive for sector risk-on and momentum into earnings/flows.

Equities.title: Moderna’s cancer-vaccine breakthrough drives broad biopharma stock rally
Equities.reason: Market-level confirmation that the Moderna news is translating into broader sector rallies — supports a risk-on tilt for cyclical/growth biotech exposure.

Equities.title: US Stocks Waver as Treasury Rally Starts to Fade: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Notes rising volatility as the Treasury rally fades (implying higher yields); negative for stretched growth/long-duration equities and a caution on market breadth.

Equities.title: U.S. stocks close higher after Treasury buyback plan triggers broad market rally
Equities.reason: Liquidity-support narrative (Treasury buyback/technical measures) that lifted the broad market — positive for equities risk sentiment and short-term market stability.

Equities.title: OpenAI 'will be a public company in 2027' or sooner, CFO Friar tells employees
Equities.summary: In an all hands meeting, Friar told employees not worry about rival Anthropic's IPO timeline.
Equities.reason: Potential large tech/AI IPOs reinforce the AI leadership narrative and equity capital markets activity — supportive for AI/large-cap tech multiples and investor attention.

Equities.title: The slow sucking sound of AI
Equities.summary: Searching for signs of crowding out
Equities.reason: Cautionary take on AI crowding/capital concentration; a modest counter-signal to the bullish AI narrative, lowering conviction on indiscriminate AI bets.

Equities.title: Nvidia plays matchmaker in Nordics, sources tell CNBC, as AI data center deals boom in region
Equities.summary: Nvidia is trying to connect GPU customers with Nordic data-center operators as cheap power and available land fuel the region’s AI infrastructure boom.
Equities.reason: Concrete evidence of continued AI infrastructure investment supporting semiconductors and data-center-related equities — reinforces AI-led market leadership.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares surge over 12% in Seoul after announcing massive stock buyback
Equities.summary: Shares of SK Hynix surged over 12% in Seoul after the company announced a massive stock buyback.
Equities.reason: Company-level buyback driving a large move in a major semiconductor name — supportive for regional tech indices and indicative of capital-return/backstop flow into equities.

Equities.title: US stock futures steady after tech slump; investors focus on Middle East tensions
Equities.reason: Geopolitical risk (Middle East) acting as a headwind for risk assets and keeping market upside constrained — a near-term negative force on sentiment.

Equities.title: Japan exports beat estimates in July as robust chip shipments power fifth straight month of gains
Equities.summary: Shipments of semiconductor equipment posted a massive 49.1% jump in value, reflecting continued demand, boosted by the artificial intelligence boom.
Equities.reason: Macro trade data confirming strong semiconductor/AI demand — supportive for exporters and cyclical tech names, reinforcing the broader AI-led equity narrative.

Rates.title: 98.75 support tested; US Dollar Index under pressure amid US debt buyback plan
Rates.summary: The US Dollar (USD) took a beating on Wednesday after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a plan to buy back long-term government debt to ease Bond yields.
Rates.reason: Treasury buyback plan is being credited with easing bond yields and weighing on the USD — clear short-term relief for bond prices. High relevance as it directly ties to Treasury action and immediate yield moves.

Rates.title: Bessent moves to curb Treasury yields, putting new pressure on Warsh's Fed
Rates.summary: Treasury's move to buy back more long-term debt cooled a bond selloff, but economists warn it could raise new inflation and independence questions for the Fed
Rates.reason: Net positive for bond prices because buybacks cooled the selloff, but important policy/credibility risks (inflation, Fed independence) temper the bullish impulse — hence moderate relevance and tempered direction.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Policy-driven yield retreat – UBS
Rates.summary: UBS' chief economist Paul Donovan notes that the United States (US) Treasury’s plan to at least double purchases of long-term US government bonds triggered a rally, pushing 10-year yields down to levels seen a week ago.
Rates.reason: UBS attributes a visible 10-year yield retreat directly to the Treasury's stepped-up purchases — a clean, high-signal link from policy to bond rally, supporting the 'buyback = lower yields' narrative.

Rates.title: Bond Yields Dive After Treasury Increases Buybacks
Rates.reason: WSJ reporting of a pronounced bond rally after the Treasury enlarged buybacks — significant market-moving confirmation that intervention materially lowered yields in the near term.

Rates.title: Bond yields edge higher as traders digest Treasury debt buyback plan
Rates.summary: Bond yields edged higher after pulling back sharply during Wednesday's session.
Rates.reason: Counter-signal: after an initial rally, yields ticked back up as traders reassessed the durability of the buyback effect — relevant as it shows market skepticism and short-term re-pricing risk.

Rates.title: Fed officials saw need for rate hike if inflation doesn't cool, minutes show
Rates.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its July 28-29 policy meeting.
Rates.reason: Fed minutes explicitly flag the conditional need for further hikes if inflation stays hot — a substantive upside risk to yields and direct negative pressure on bond prices.

Rates.title: Bond relief ebbs, stocks fall as investors question Treasury's rescue efforts
Rates.reason: Market skepticism about the sustainability and credibility of Treasury 'rescue' buybacks is starting to show up in price action — medium relevance negative signal for bond market durability.

Rates.title: US government debt hits $40tn as borrowing rises at historic rate
Rates.summary: Public spending surges despite Trump’s vow to stabilise America’s finances
Rates.reason: Structural backdrop of soaring US debt and record borrowing implies longer-term upward pressure on yields and makes Treasury intervention a temporary backstop rather than a permanent fix — negative for rates.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains traction on fading Fed rate hike bets, US-Canada tariff pause
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair declines to around 1.3790 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) as cooling US inflation dampens aggressive US Federal Reserve (Fed) policy expectations.
FX.reason: Direct FX piece showing CAD strength vs USD driven by softer US policy expectations — fits USD-weak narrative tied to lower yields/less hawkish Fed. High relevance as it ties commodity-linked CAD moves and macro drivers into USD direction.

FX.title: US Dollar: Risk-on pattern with softer DXY – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes that US Treasury buy-back operations and a drop in longer-dated yields have supported equities and weighed on the Dollar.
FX.reason: Broad USD-centric macro narrative: Treasury buybacks and falling long-end yields weakening the DXY and supporting risk assets. High direction and relevance as this is a cross-market driver for major USD pairs.

FX.title: US Dollar: Upside capped as yields ease – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes the US Dollar weakened after US Treasury Secretary Bessent announced a major expansion of long-dated Treasury buybacks, which pushed long-end yields lower.
FX.reason: Confirms the core theme (Treasury buybacks -> lower yields -> weaker USD). Included as a corroborating market-strategy view with moderate relevance.

FX.title: British Pound gains as US Dollar softens on Treasury bond buybacks
FX.summary: GBP/USD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 1.3630 during the European hours on Thursday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) faces challenges, driven by the decision of the US Treasury Department to stabilize domestic bond
FX.reason: Currency-specific confirmation of USD weakness transmission into GBPUSD on the Treasury buyback / yield story. Strong path-dependence to the broader USD narrative, so moderately high relevance.

FX.title: Euro: Upside bias targets 1.1725 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD has broken to a three‑month high near 1.1680 as Dollar weakness and strong momentum underpin the pair.
FX.reason: EURUSD breakout narrative linked to overall Dollar softness. Relevant as a major USD-pair confirming the cross-market drivers (weaker yields / Treasury actions).

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Doubling US bond-buying plan opens way for 1.1800
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) posts a fresh three-month high at around 1.1693 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Price-forecast / technical piece tied to the buyback story. Technical/forecast content capped at lower relevance per framework, but it reinforces the USD-weak/ EUR-strong view.

FX.title: PBOC Moves to Slow Yuan Gains With Weaker-Than-Expected Fixing
FX.reason: Central-bank FX operation aimed at preventing CNY appreciation (weaker-than-expected fixing) implies USD/CNY strength and signals China FX-management. This is a currency-specific intervention that acts as a partial counter to broad USD-weakness flows; moderate relevance for regional USD dynamics.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances on RBNZ hawkish outlook
FX.summary: NZD/USD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.5950 during the European hours on Thursday. The pair appreciates as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) gains on expectations of another rate hike from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) in
FX.reason: Central-bank-driven NZD strength vs USD (RBNZ hawkish). Relevant as it contributes to the USD-weak narrative via differentiated global rate expectations and local hikes.

FX.title: Japanese Yen underperforms amid rising trade concerns
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is down against its major currency peers on Thursday, with USD/JPY trading 0.22% higher at around 158.50 during the European trading session. The Japanese currency underperforms as the Trade Deficit widens due to elevated energy prices.
FX.reason: JPY weakness driven by trade/energy shocks produces USD/JPY upside (USD strength vs JPY), a localized counter-signal to the broad USD-weak theme. Included at lower relevance as it's driven by country-specific trade dynamics rather than the Treasury buyback theme.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: Elevated Oil keeps INR lagging against US Dollar – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note Indian Rupee (INR) remains under pressure despite broader US Dollar (USD) weakness, as high Oil prices and importer Dollar demand weigh on the currency.
FX.reason: Country-specific counter-signal: INR weakness despite general USD softness due to elevated oil/importer dollar demand. Lower relevance as this is a localized flow that does not overturn the broader USD-weak regime.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Near $4,500 as US Treasury Buyback Sends Yields Lower
Commodities.reason: Lower Treasury yields reduce opportunity cost of holding gold, supporting bullion prices; clear market driver for gold.

Commodities.title: Gold hovers near early-June high on lower bond yields
Commodities.reason: Reinforces dominant narrative that falling bond yields are supporting gold; useful corroborating item but somewhat redundant.

Commodities.title: Gold bears seem hesitant as sustained USD selling offsets hawkish Fed and Iran risks
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone below the $4,500 mark through the first half of the European session on Thursday. Wednesday's hawkish FOMC Minutes turn out to be a key factor undermining the bullion.
Commodities.reason: Counter-signal: hawkish Fed minutes and USD strength weigh on gold, but USD selling elsewhere partly offsets — lower relevance relative to yield-driven bullish theme.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD stands tall near $67 supported by US Treasury’s buybacks
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) is practically flat on Thursday, holding most of Wednesday’s gains, trading just above $67.00 at the European session opening.
Commodities.reason: Lower yields / Treasury buybacks supporting precious metals flow through to silver; market-level driver with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Operational advances raising Permian output increase supply for both crude and gas — price-negative for oil and natural gas at the margin.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. gas production materially increases global supply prospects and weighs on natural gas prices — significant fundamental bearish impulse for gas.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Increased U.S. intra-country crude/product flows relieve regional tightness on West Coast — modestly bearish for regional crude differentials; limited market impact.

Commodities.reason: Physical tightness (despite recent LME inventory uptick) supports copper prices — relevant fundamental support for industrial metals.

Commodities.title: Chinese Refiners Snap Up Iraqi Oil as More Supplies Exit Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Shifts in flows and Chinese buying of Iraqi barrels as supplies reroute away from Hormuz tighten available seaborne supply and raise oil risk premium — significant bullish signal for crude.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Four-Day Gain as Traders Assess Middle East Stalemate
Commodities.reason: Continued gains around Middle East tensions and supply concerns are supporting crude; reinforces the prevailing oil-risk premium narrative.

Commodities.title: Oil: Rally extends on sanctions risk – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Ewa Manthey and Warren Patterson note Oil has extended its rally for a fifth straight session, with ICE Brent above $92 and WTI over $86 as markets react to tighter US sanctions on Iran.
Commodities.reason: Sanctions risk on Iranian exports is a clear supply-side tightening driver sustaining the oil rally — meaningful but not singularly novel.

Commodities.title: Oil prices rise to highest level in nearly a month amid Hormuz impasse
Commodities.reason: Prices pushing higher on Hormuz-related shipping/flow concerns and sanctions — supports ongoing rally, moderate-market impact.

Commodities.title: Somali pirate menace returns as U.S.-Iran war stokes regional chaos and saps enforcement resources
Commodities.summary: Somali piracy incidents have resurged in the Red Sea region in recent times, especially since the U.S.-Iran war kicked off-major concern for shipping companies.
Commodities.reason: Rising piracy and diverted enforcement resources increase shipping risk and transits costs, modestly supportive of oil and freight-sensitive commodity risk premia.
